top_signals.title: Dollar Powers to Best Month Since June on Fed’s Inflation Fight
top_signals.summary: The dollar is wrapping up its best month since June as the Federal Reserve’s renewed focus on taming inflation pushed interest-rate expectations and US bond yields higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
